attribution.DEE: Material two-bit inputs, existing selector history, Native encounters and frozen RAW readers yield an emission. USE may invoke Native lexicon and comparison.
attribution.P0_host: Generic view/codec configuration, external objects/versions, environment cache/cursor, tool pipeline, fixed cadence and posteffect quality are prepared. New quality does not redefine old work gain.
attribution.history: Same post10 common prefix for view arms, separate SAFE prefix for early reserve. Never sum diverged histories into MAIN.
attribution.failure: Unclean STOP/process guard leaves a last committed observation plus unresolved operation, not a proven final complete future, content erasure or cognitive death.
attribution.sample: Repeated opportunities/forks of a common prefix are dependent; source counts do not equal simultaneous inputs or acquired semantics.
